@ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 (https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm), dist/esm, unmodified.
License: MIT (as declared in the package's package.json).

The ffmpeg core (@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10, GPL-2.0-or-later) is NOT bundled here;
the app downloads it from a CDN at runtime only when the browser cannot decode a file itself.
